events.continuity_hook: The Sunday outbound and Inner Harbor hotel remain unchanged, and only the replacement Tuesday flight needs to be finalized before departure.
events.interaction_goal: Confirm the no-cost 7:40 p.m. connecting return, verify its Detroit connection time and baggage handling, obtain the revised ticket details, and preserve the existing outbound and hotel reservations.
events.scenario_brief: The airline has confirmed that the retimed 4:55 p.m. Tuesday nonstop cannot be restored. Maya still expects the workshop to end at 4:30 p.m.; the no-cost 7:40 p.m. itinerary through Detroit allows a practical trip to Baltimore/Washington airport and reaches Minneapolis at 11:18 p.m., while the 6:50 p.m. nonstop on another carrier remains available for an additional $173.

events.continuity_hook: All travel is confirmed, but the duplicate return display creates uncertainty about which boarding passes and record details are valid.
events.interaction_goal: Check the ticket status for each segment, identify the active Tuesday return, confirm that the obsolete flight requires no action, and produce a concise final schedule with airport-transfer timing.
events.scenario_brief: On departure day, the revised itinerary shows the correct Sunday nonstop to Baltimore and Tuesday connection through Detroit, but the airline application still displays the canceled 4:55 p.m. flight beside the active return. The hotel has Maya's arrival notation, and the workshop address and Tuesday luggage-storage arrangement are unchanged.

events.continuity_hook: A new two-night client trip begins with flight timing, airport-to-hotel transportation, and a practical lodging area still unresolved.
events.interaction_goal: Establish workable Tuesday outbound and Thursday return windows, compare complete flight itineraries within the airfare limit, estimate local transportation, and identify lodging areas that support both client days.
events.scenario_brief: Maya needs to travel from Minneapolis to Raleigh for a Wednesday morning implementation review and Thursday training sessions ending at 3:30 p.m. She can leave Tuesday after 1:00 p.m., must be home Thursday night, has an airfare ceiling of $700, and can spend up to $255 per hotel night before tax. The client site is in North Hills, and no reservations have been made.

events.continuity_hook: The airport and lodging area are established, so the round trip must now balance fare, Tuesday arrival, and a reachable Thursday departure.
events.interaction_goal: Compare total travel time, fares, connection details, baggage charges, and Thursday transfer margins; eliminate the infeasible early return; and select a complete itinerary under the airfare ceiling.
events.scenario_brief: Raleigh-Durham is the only practical airport, and two hotel nights near North Hills are expected. A $584 nonstop leaves Minneapolis at 2:40 p.m. Tuesday and arrives at 6:12 p.m.; a $497 one-stop itinerary arrives at 9:26 p.m. Thursday returns include a nonstop at 5:55 p.m. for a $632 round trip and a $548 pairing that departs at 4:45 p.m., leaving too little time after training and the drive to the airport.

events.continuity_hook: Flight dates and arrival timing are fixed, leaving the real lodging totals, site access, and Thursday checkout logistics to determine the hotel.
events.interaction_goal: Calculate two-night totals with taxes and parking, verify the actual route to the client site, confirm late check-in and Thursday luggage storage, compare rideshare costs, and choose a room within the nightly limit.
events.scenario_brief: The $632 nonstop round trip is selected, with a Tuesday hotel arrival near 7:15 p.m. Three North Hills options are available for two nights: a hotel beside the client building at $249 nightly before tax, a $218 property eleven minutes away by car with a $16 nightly parking charge, and a $236 property across a major roadway that advertises a short walking distance but has no direct pedestrian crossing.

events.continuity_hook: The trip components are selected, but ticketing, room confirmation, and a final date-and-time reconciliation remain to be completed.
events.interaction_goal: Recheck the Tuesday-through-Thursday schedule and projected cost, ticket the expiring flights, reserve the refundable hotel with the arrival estimate, and assemble one chronological itinerary with confirmation status and Thursday airport timing.
events.scenario_brief: Maya has chosen the hotel beside the client building for $574 after tax and the $632 nonstop flights. Estimated rideshares between the airport and North Hills add $82, for a projected trip total of $1,288. The airfare quote expires that afternoon, while the room is refundable until three days before arrival and needs an estimated Tuesday check-in time.
